dashboard_text_tile.title: Optional masked session replay
dashboard_text_tile.body: Open [native session replay](https://eu.posthog.com/project/295060/replay) to investigate opted-in navigation and interface layout. Recordings mask all text and inputs and replace private app surfaces with placeholders. Both app and website recording are separately opt-in and off by default. Filter by associated page-view renderer/version. Replay is wireframe only; missing recordings do not imply zero usage. Native ingestion verification is pending deployment.

note: Native snapshots use the dedicated /s/ ingestion pipeline; do not count $snapshot as an ordinary product event.
